reviews.title: Failed log in - again!!!
reviews.text: Regularly the log in doesn’t work so can’t use in store.

reviews.title: Terrible update
reviews.text: Since the app update, I can’t now log back into my account. Every time I use the log-in link and give my mobile number to get the access code it then takes me to the finish my registration page, I fill out the request info, name and email, and it then says I can’t use that info as an account already exists. I know that as I am trying to log back into my account.

reviews.title: App use
reviews.text: It’s good update your card design

reviews.title: Poor sign in process
reviews.text: Poor sign in when you really need the app. Not impressed
It says u get 1000 points worth a £5 off fuel if u join but I’ve not got any and I have joined in October before the November deadline

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: It’s a scam, although advertised everywhere that you will get £5 off, most BP petrol stations don’t even participate and even the ones that do won’t give you £5 off unless you have purchased 25 litres of petrol. With their prices this makes the £5 off a waste of time.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: This used to work really well, but after recent updates, it increasingly fails. I often get as far as selecting which pump to use, but when I click on it, it returns to the previous page, and goes into a loop of uselessness. I’ve wasted so much time at fuel stations that I’ve now given up using it– if it ain’t broke, don’t bloody fix it!

reviews.title: Acc deleted no reason
reviews.text: How come you delete acc last 10 years saved my rewards points.

reviews.title: Handy when it used to work
reviews.text: Norfolk will become an independent nation and invent affordable nuclear fusion before this app actually works

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Try to log in to the app which is fine then it wants me to register when I’m already a member collecting points. So stuck and can’t get in. Have tried to get support but no reponse.

reviews.title: Not as good as they say.
reviews.text: When it works it’s good,  but so unreliable tbh.

reviews.title: £5 free? 🤔
reviews.text: told me i would get £5 free and of-course, i didn’t expect to actually get the £5 to use, but i couldn’t even spend it on fuel because they’re ’promotional points’. Absolute waste of time and a login. Just a trap to get you to use their app.

reviews.title: Constantly does not work
reviews.text: It always puzzles me how a company with that much money as BP has, can do such an awful app. Constantly logs out, won’t connect, won’t find a location, 500 error, 403 on login. Terrible!

reviews.title: Points redemption error
reviews.text: I’m not able to convert my points to amazon voucher and I have checked with my friends and it never worked for anyone. It feels like a scam as you can only use the points in-store and cannot redeem as a gift card of amazon or any other as the app advertise.

reviews.title: No reward !!
reviews.text: I don’t know why ? I scanned each time I went to petrol station but the number won’t go up !!!

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Won’t allow me to log in to redeem my points. Not worth having on phone.

reviews.title: Prolonged IT issues leading to no access to app
reviews.text: Last four trips to a BP garage, can’t access the App, very frustrating, now opting to delete and go to Sainsbury’s and collect points there!

reviews.title: Absolutely Atrocious
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, just gets worse and worse this app..

It used to be really good, but the constant improvements are to the detriment of the usability of the app.

reviews.title: Dreadful
reviews.text: Worst fuel app out there

reviews.title: Same Awful experience
reviews.text:
All of a sudden my app doesn’t work. I asked an employee at the petrol station and he said it is common after updates. But couldn’t help. So I deleted the app and lost my rewards, reinstalled and same problem. Deleted again , turned off my phone , and all back on with the app still not working. Error 403. 
As prior review, this should not be happening to a major company

reviews.title: APP IS BROKEN
reviews.text: Doesn’t work anymore! Comes up as error when you select log in. Deleted and reinstalled and still doesn’t work! 🤬

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: The app is physically unusable. You can’t log in. The only flow is to register, even if you press on login. It then fails because “there’s email address already an account linked to this email”. Well yes… I know! Hopeless waste of time

reviews.title: Payment never works!
reviews.text: This app never works for payment at pump on the app. Constantly states payment failed. I have tried multiple cards and rarely manage to pay at the pump with the app.

reviews.title: Was good now Terrible!
reviews.text: Haven’t been able to view my points for ages. Keeps asking me to register when I try to log in and no matter what I try it just comes back with error. I assume all my points are now obsolete? Thanks BP. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Being forced to register, again!
reviews.text: I’m trying to login, but it just wants me to re-register again.  And, it fails at that step too.

reviews.title: Cant use pay at pump
reviews.text: After this update, Continue button disabled If choosing bp plus fuel card.

reviews.title: Terrible app that doesn’t want to open on my phone.
reviews.text: The app won’t open, it just always closes on me. I use my bp card weekly on my phone and have just received an email today to say my accounts been closed because I don’t login to the app which won’t even open on my phone.

reviews.title: Fix the bug please
reviews.text: This was a great app but the current version will not login when trying to pay for fuel at the pump. It’s such a nuisance.

reviews.title: Unable to login
reviews.text: Updated app and not able to login

reviews.title: Can not register
reviews.text: Can not register, keep saying something gone wrong. We are working on it last 5 days

reviews.title: Stopped working.
reviews.text: Just stopped working and no update about a fix. Poor.

reviews.title: Impossible to add card and register
reviews.text: With all card details and address correct and a approval sent to the banking app and confirmed there — the Bp app keeps showing “something went wrong” and there is no way to cancel or start over - permanent error, just waste of time

reviews.title: Can’t use
reviews.text: Doesn’t even work anymore

reviews.title: Can’t login in!
reviews.text: Your app doesn’t work!

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: Keeps asking me to register when I already have an account despite clicking the Login button rather than the Register button. If I try to register it says my email address already has an account. It does! It’s my account duh!

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: It’s such an awful app, only works when it wants too

reviews.title: Doesn’t work!
reviews.text:
Used to use this to pay at the pump all the time, then it just stopped working a few months ago. I’ve waited to see if it would be fixed. I’ve deleted the app and reinstalled it. Still doesn’t work. 

Every time I select a pump and try to proceed the screen just reloads. Happens at every petrol station. 

Tried contacting support through the AI bot and wrote this all in a form then that kept failing to submit!

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Constantly offline login problems useless message to try later for over 2 weeks

reviews.title: MNisar
reviews.text:
Life is no longer fun without Billo rani Queen Yere.
3 years have passed. B&M warehouse Bedford

reviews.title: Unreliable app
reviews.text:
Most unreliable app on my phone. If I have to log in one more time that takes forever to do following yet another one of your updates I will be reliving the app and using an alternative provider for fuel. This will include anyone who works for me. This has become a joke. When it works it’s great. When it logs you out it’s a nightmare to regain access and a lot of stations are down
When you get to the forecourt. Now when this happens I drove to the next petrol station, if I’m going into a shop with someone doing their weekly shop to pay for my fuel, I’m going elsewhere.
